title: Boyhood fighting with white boys; saving Wooden Joe and Lulu Pascal
summary: Glass tells of being the only Black boy in the Elysian Fields gang, hiding from Louie Morgan, and rescuing Wooden Joe and Lulu Pascal from white boys who cut Joe's fingers.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Well you see, they're around Lindsey Phil and Claymore, they didn't allow them colored fellas to be around there. I was the only colored fellas used to hang up around there because I would come up there and I would work them by Dr. Tudrick, you know. I stayed there. But when them colored fellas would come around there, they'd be fighting and going on, they'd be running them. Well I was the only colored fellas. I'd be in a gang with the white fellas, they'd have to run them too, you know. Though when they'd do me something, you see when they'd do me something, I'd get the stick and I'd beat them. You see when I'd whip them, I'd run hard. The white boy, Louis Morgan there, he was the copper, captain of the police force. And he'd say, where Booker T. at? I'd run and hide in the system. Dr. Tudrick had a big system, you know, with the brick around the system. I'd get up in that system, I'd stay there and tell him Dr. Tudrick. But when they'd come look for me, I wouldn't come out. Dr. Tudrick would come and he'd call me when I'd come out. I'd know he was there. Nobody wasn't going to do me nothing. He'd go, Booker, what you done? I said, I didn't do nothing. He said, well Booker didn't do nothing. He said, because Booker never tell a lie. I used to sit in the middle of the table there. Yeah, I'd whip them with a stick. Yeah, I'd whip them with a stick, you see. My words went before them boys, because you know I wouldn't fight them if they didn't do me something. And I'd fight them all, beat them with a stick. I'd catch them in the head, beat them, throw them on the ground. My name is in that tree at Legend Field and Clayborne. That big tree right on the corner. They got much of concrete in there. My name is written in there. You pay that little. When you were a little boy you did? When I was a boy. I was a boy. I was a devil. Wooden Joe got his fingers cut like that, coming from Mel and Boyd. Well I always wondered, what was that? I knew he had him cut because he was coming from the picnic. He was coming from playing the picnic, about eleven o'clock that night. Him and Lulu Pascal. That was the last train, you know. Him and Lulu Pascal?
He was coming in. And he was bringing Lulu home. Where Lulu played? Lulu don't play nothing. She was coming, he was bringing her home. She went on the picnic.
Oh, wow, it was his chick.
Yeah, yeah, he was bringing her home, you see. And they got there, them boys was cutting at him and he throwed his hand up. Cut all them fingers. I saved him.

Them white boys, the Lindenfield and Claiborne. They call them the twins. There was a bunch of brothers, they called the twins there. They was bad. Well, you saved him, huh? Yeah, I stopped them by me being around there, you see. I told them don't do anything. That was your gang? Yeah, that was all my gang, you see. And I saved Joe and Lulu. They had Lulu piled up in glass bottle. Twenty cases of bottles, empty bottles. They had her between the steps. They had done broke all them bottles, throwing at her. She was standing up in between the steps. They just throwing them, busting them on the pavement at her. They had done run to Joe and cut Joe's fingers almost off. He threw his head. And I saved her. I believe Lulu living yet, Lulu Pascal?

Yeah. Wait, no wait, let me see. After you have Lulu Pascal. I think she's living in Joe Pascal living. Wait a minute. Yeah, they carried him there. I don't know if she's living under that. I mean, I heard that name.
I heard that name. I heard that name. I heard that name.
I heard that name about this about, or not about a mother. Joe Pascal, he's a slater, a roofer.
